sources.label: Chiggi
sources.author: Chiggi
patch_list: Block All Login Screens
Stops the central login action and reports cancellation to its callback. Server-session features become unavailable instead of opening login.
Block Telemetry & Trackers
Neutralizes Google AppMeasurement, AppsFlyer, ByteDance AppLog, APM/Slardar, Gecko, Pitaya, BDTuring, and UserGrowth event dispatchers.
Bypass Effects Region Restriction
Fixes effects, transitions, and templates failing to load (ByteDance Shark WAF block) by spoofing device_platform to 'windows' and resetting deviceId in effect requests.
Bypass GeoBlock Region Restriction
Forces CapCut GeoBlock config lists (cert, dock, entrance, page, scheme) to empty so region-blocked surfaces stay enabled. Server-refused content may still fail to load.
Bypass Signature Check

Spoofs the official APK signature, suppresses local and server-driven cracking notices, prevents cracking-verdict persistence, and disables Godzilla and PGL integrity gates so re-signed builds are not blocked.
Bypass Unsafe Package Modal
Replaces both the default and runtime-overridden crack-guide schema with the template portal URL so the blocking security notice cannot reopen after remote settings load.
Change Package Name

Changes CapCut's manifest package and package-bound authorities, permissions, actions, schemes, hosts, and instrumentation targets for side-by-side install. Login, deep links, and server identity may break.
Disable Forced Update
Disables CapCut's server-driven update popup gate.
Do Not Persist Cracking Verdict
Stops CapCut from persisting server cracking verdicts in the local crackingInfo preferences. Automatically included by Bypass Signature Check.
Hide VPN and Proxy Flags
Reports VPN/proxy flags false without touching TTNet VPN routing or network IDs. Server IP reputation remains visible.
Locale Assets Slimmer

Strips unselected CapCut asset locale bundles (assets/locales/*.json) from the APK. English is always preserved. For res/values-* string tables use the canonical universal Remove Extra Languages patch.
Neutralize Play Billing
Stubs Google Play Billing client calls and disables billing manifest components for graceful degradation on devices without GMS.
Redirect API to v2 Boot
Redirects blocked editor, template-category/feed, commerce, and passport requests to official v2-boot endpoints so template tabs load without waiting for the default-host timeout.
Remove Ads
Disables CapCut ad configuration and splash gates, then completes export and template reward-ad callbacks through the app's supported auto-skip result.
Remove Login Prompts
Suppresses cold-start and export login prompts. Cloud, AI and social server features still require a real session.
Remove Watermark
Forces CapCut watermark-removal gates and default ending gate to allow export without watermark or outro.
Spoof Region to USA
Reports US app, carrier, SIM, network and locale regions. Use with a US VPN; the server still sees the source IP. Does not alter stateful store_region echoes.
Unlock Premium

Ported from kveld9/kveld-extra-morphe-patches (GPLv3). Forces CapCut VIP gates to return true (SubscribeImpl, PayVipImpl, UserVipInfo, UserDetailInfo, VipUserServiceImpl, SubscribeCloudImpl) plus central account status flags (BusinessManag…
Unlock Premium Templates
Unlocks CapCut 20.0.0 premium template gates and removes the logged-out template lock. Ported from kveld9/kveld-extra-morphe-patches (GPLv3), with corrected 20.0.0 R8 mappings.
Unlock Ultra HD Export
Forces CapCut Ultra HD / high-resolution export gates to unlocked so 4K export options stay available.
Unlock Ultra Plan

Reports CapCut Ultra as the active locally purchased tier, sets a non-expiring local benefit end date, and disables renewal, cancellation, trial, and expiry-warning states. Server-side credits and cloud entitlements are not granted.

Bypass GeoBlock Region Restriction

Bypass Signature Check

Spoofs the official APK signature (SHA-256) for tamper telemetry, drops the server-driven signature blacklist, silences the abnormal-source toast, and disables the Godzilla inject-detect gate so re-signed builds are not blocked.
Bypass Unsafe Package Modal

Replaces the unsafe-package modal fallback URL in the Lynx schema defaults with the real template portal URL so region-blocked or untrusted-client fallbacks open templates instead of the blocking security notice.
Locale Assets Slimmer

Strips unselected CapCut asset locale bundles (assets/locales/*.json) from the APK. English is always preserved. For res/values-* string tables use the canonical universal Remove Extra Languages patch.
Native Bloat Slimmer

Strips non-essential companion native libraries by zeroing bytes in-situ. Always zeroes AppLovin ad crash reporter. WARNING: Stripping speech recognition and synthesis engines (libspeech*.so) disables voice recognition, voiceover captions,…
Neutralize Play Billing
Stubs Google Play Billing client calls and disables billing manifest components for graceful degradation on devices without GMS.
Redirect API to v2 Boot
Loads effects, feeds and templates where default endpoints are blocked by using official alternate endpoints.
Remove Watermark
Forces CapCut watermark-removal gates and default ending gate to allow export without watermark or outro.
Unlock Premium

Forces CapCut VIP gates to return true (SubscribeImpl, PayVipImpl, UserVipInfo, UserDetailInfo, VipUserServiceImpl, SubscribeCloudImpl) plus central account status flags (BusinessManager). Cloud-gated assets may still fail.
Unlock Premium Templates
Marks premium template styles as available so locked template features stay usable.
Unlock Ultra HD Export
Forces CapCut Ultra HD / high-resolution export gates to unlocked so 4K export options stay available.

sources.label: Personal Morphe patch bundle
sources.author: riky
patch_list: Bypass effects region restriction
Fixes effects/transitions not loading (Shark WAF block) by spoofing device_platform from "android" to "windows" in effect API requests.
CapCut network tunnel
Opt-in CapCut-only WireGuard tunnel. Import your own wg-quick .conf (paste or file) in-app; traffic is scoped to CapCut only. Requires Android VPN consent once. Independent of Unlock Premium.
Unlock Premium
Forces CapCut 9.0 VIP gates to true (VipSubscribeManager, SubscribeImpl, UserVipInfo, benefits). Cloud-gated assets may still fail.
